column_description: BIGSERIAL. Auto-generated unique identifier for conservation record. PK = Conservation(CureRegistry).
TEXT. Reference to associated archeologys project. FK to Projects.
TEXT. Reference to site requiring conservation attention. FK to Sites.
TEXT. Damage assessment evaluation results. **NULL means damage assessment not conducted or evaluation pending.**. Possible values: Minor, Moderate, Severe.
TEXT. Conservation priority ranking classification. Possible values: Critical priority, immediate conservation required.
TEXT. Structural stability assessment status. Possible values: Moderate condition, careful monitoring required.
TEXT. History of previous conservation interventions. **NULL means no prior conservation interventions recorded or documentation unavailable.**. Possible values: Major, Minor.
TEXT. Previous documentation and records available. **NULL means no previous documentation exists or records not accessible.**. Possible values: Complete, Partial.
